title: Opportunities
description: Maps to the existing projects collection (gig/collaboration postings — someone looking for a collaborator), per the round-2 reconciliation — folded in rather than a separate gig_opportunities collection. Distinct from the "Add Portfolio" flow (finished creative work someone already made). CONFIRMED 2026-08-12 (grounded Explore audit): 100% missing, not just unconfirmed. Zero `.collection("projects")` calls anywhere in the app; `ProjectSchema` (BackendSchemas.kt:112) is defined but never instantiated. The only browse/apply UI (SuccessAndDashboardScreens.kt:2174-2435) is commented-out or unreachable dead code whose own copy admits "Opportunities are coming soon." `UnifiedOpportunityCard` is defined but never called. A "Live Opportunities Feed" nav item exists but routes to an unrelated business-storefront screen. `ChatContext.OPPORTUNITY` is just a messaging-inbox filter tab around one hardcoded demo message, not a posting/browsing flow.
